_readme: What the deployed page does with two games. This directory names no game, so check.sh and
pack_check.sh run it with no --game= at all - the only sessions that meet the title's Switch
game row, because the flag is exactly what hides it. It picks The Barred Gate: Arena and
starts it, and asserts the game that is running rather than anything both games share.

steps.text: the title, with two games in the build and nothing choosing. Games are offered in id order, so The Barred Gate shows first. Rows: Continue, New game, Credits, Options, Switch game - nothing is saved, so the cursor opens on New game, and two presses up reach Switch game: one onto Continue and one that wraps round the top
the title now wears The Barred Gate: Arena, with the cursor still on Switch game. Down wraps onto Continue, and down again is New game
